thought
Hold on! Let's look at Q3's answer again:
"I work as a fleet technician at one of the drone operating companies. My job is to keep drones and charging equipment in working order. I add new drones to the fleet, retire old ones, set up charging pads at our sites, take drones out of service for repairs and put them back, and send drones to charge."
Why did they answer Q3, and say "I don't know." to literally every other question?
Let's think! Maybe the interviewee LLM only answers questions about what they need the new service to let them do, OR rules/constraints of those specific actions!
Wait: in Q6 I asked "what information do you have to record or look up?" -> "I don't know."
In Q8 I asked "When you take a drone out of service for repairs, what needs to happen so nobody tries to use it?" -> "I don't know."
Why?! What CAN this interviewee answer? Let's ask an open question about what rules or problems come up in those tasks, or what they can tell us about drones and charging pads! Let's test!What can you tell me about how drones and charging pads work at your company?
